Wie passt es in meinen Tag?: How does it fit into my day?
Feste Mischung von der Stange. Die Menge: A one-size-fits-all mix. The amounts rarely suit you, and with more products on top you quickly double up on single nutrients.
Welche Form, welche Menge, wann? Einzeln: Which form, how much, when? Bought on its own, you have to work that out yourself. Too much at once often upsets digestion.
Wenn du daneben Acerola oder Multivitami: If you also take acerola or a multivitamin, you can quickly overdo it.
Zu viel ist nicht harmlos, zu wenig brin: Too much isn't harmless, too little does nothing. And coffee or tea right alongside slows absorption.
Hochdosiert über längere Zeit bringt es: High doses over a long time throw off your copper balance. The amount has to fit the rest.
Große Einzeldosen nimmt der Körper schle: The body absorbs large single doses less well than smaller portions. And it needs vitamin D, which contributes to normal absorption.
Fettlöslich: Ohne etwas Fett dazu kommt: Fat-soluble: without a little fat alongside, little gets absorbed. And it belongs together with magnesium and vitamin K.
Wasserlöslich: Was der Körper gerade nic: Water-soluble: what your body doesn't need right now, it excretes. So big doses at once do little.
Ohne Vitamin E oxidiert es schnell. Die: Without vitamin E it oxidizes quickly. The benefits can be lost.
Fettlöslich und teuer. Auf nüchternen Ma: Fat-soluble and pricey. On an empty stomach little of it gets absorbed.
Die Spanne zwischen sinnvoll und zu viel: The gap between useful and too much is small. Bought on its own, you quickly end up with too much.
Gehalt und Qualität schwanken stark. Ohn: Content and quality vary a lot. Without standardization you never know what's really inside.
Magensäure setzt vielen Stämmen zu. Du m: Stomach acid is tough on many strains. You have to get the timing right.
High doses can mask a B12 deficiency. Both need to be balanced.
Gehört zu Vitamin D und Calcium. Einzeln: Belongs with vitamin D and calcium. Bought on its own, one of the partners is usually missing.
Einzelne Aminosäuren in hoher Dosis verd: Single amino acids in high doses crowd out others during absorption. The ratio matters.
Steckt voller Vitamin C. Mit anderen Vit: Packed with vitamin C. Easy to overdo when combined with other vitamin C sources.
Wird ohne Vitamin C kaum richtig aufgeba: Hardly builds up properly without vitamin C. You need to combine both.
Als Extrakt stark konzentriert. Dosis un: Highly concentrated as an extract. Dose and quality vary from product to product.
Bei dauerhafter Einnahme verliert es sei: Loses its effect when taken continuously. You have to build in breaks.
Einzeln hochdosiert ist mehr nicht besse: High doses on their own aren't better. It belongs in natural amounts in a mix with other carotenoids.
